headline: Discussed the 2026 Nashua ornament, fourth-quarter events, a downtown placemaking survey, vacant properties, and other programs; no votes recorded.
summary: Members heard an update on the 2026 Nashua holiday ornament and fourth-quarter events, including Monster Mash, Main St Unwrapped, Plaid Friday, and Stroll. Liz Hannan presented on a placemaking survey, vacant properties, a leadership program, a coloring book, and Activate Nashua Academy, which starts February 2027. The minutes record no votes or decisions.
plain_text:
Downtown Improvement Committee 
October 9, 2026 
In Attendance: Attending: Marylou Blaisdell, Edward Haynes, Michael Buckley, Rich Lannan, 
Cole Morgan, Elisa Drift, Hannan Liz 
Also, in attendance Alyssa O’Mera – GAD, Alderman Amber Morgan 
Meeting called to order at 7:45 a.m. 
Alyssa O’Mera showed the committee the 2026 Nashua ornament for the holiday season. Price 
and how to distribute to businesses that choose to sell it with be updated in the next few weeks. 
The events for the last quarter of the year are all moving forward which includes 
• Monster Mash 
• Main St Unwrapped 
• Plaid Friday 
• Stroll 
Liz Hannan presented the following updates 
• Downtown Placemaking Survey from Beyond Walls – slide show of the proposed 
placemaking plan for the area and the date of implemented. 
• Vacant Properties and absentee landlords – discussion on vacant property and how 
to get owners to respond to potential renters. 
• Recast Your City Leadership Program 
• Coloring and Activity Book distribution – this book will be given to all 3-4th grades in 
Nashua, copies are also for businesses to hand out. 
• Activate Nashua Academy – this program will start February 2027 
The meeting adjourned at 8:50 a.m.
